description: Looks up the mobile phone number of named people (personal data: the person's own mobile, for business prospecting). Takes 1 to 25 entries in people, looked up 5 at a time. Each person is identified by what is known about them: full name with company name or domain, LinkedIn URL, work or personal e-mail, location, or the CNPJ of the company where they are a partner. First it checks this workspace (people sheets, campaigns and kept briefs): a value already saved comes back free, with savedIn naming where it was saved; refresh true skips that check. Otherwise it asks Nock's data sources one after another and stops at the first that finds it. value is the mobile number. Before a number is kept it is checked against the registry's owner of the line: phoneOwner is confirmed (the owner has the person's name) or unconfirmed (the registry has no name for it); a number registered to someone else is dropped and not charged (phonesDiscarded counts them). A number found for a person of this workspace's campaigns or people sheets is written into that person's empty phone field (prospectId, or sheetId with rowId; the LinkedIn profile also matches), and savedTo says where; a number already there is never replaced. Returns one entry per person or business in the order sent (index), each with person (whose it is), status found, not_found or error, value and creditsCharged, plus the totals found, notFound, failed and creditsCharged. not_found with sourcesUnanswered means some sources did not answer in time and a later try may find it; error means no source answered. The same entry sent twice is looked up once (sameAsIndex). Costs 20 credits per value found. Nothing is charged when it is not found, the lookup fails or the value was already saved. A lookup can take up to about a minute per entry.

people.description: Who to look up, 1 to 25 entries, each with what is known of them.

cnpj.description: The CNPJ of a company where the person is a partner, when known.

companyDomain.description: The site domain of the company where the person works.

companyName.description: The name of the company where the person works.

fullName.description: The person's full name, with companyName or companyDomain.

location.description: Person location hint used to reject off-country phones.

prospectId.description: The campaign prospect this lookup is for, when known: a mobile found is saved to them.

rowId.description: The sheet row this lookup is for, with sheetId: a mobile found is saved to its phone column.

sheetId.description: The people sheet of the row this lookup is for, with rowId.

refresh.description: True skips what this workspace has saved and looks the value up outside again.
